caption: The drawing depicts a doll seated against a plain beige background. The doll has a painted face with visible rosy cheeks, red lips, dark eyebrows, and black eyes. Its hair is dark and styled in two braids. The doll is wearing a broad-brimmed straw hat adorned with a pink ribbon, part of which forms a bow at the side and another ribbon drapes down. The doll’s outfit consists of a long, full, white dress with vertical pink stripes and scattered small red flower patterns, cinched at the waist. Over the dress, there is a translucent, short-sleeved blouse with blue and white lace trim along the sleeves and edges. The doll’s arms and legs are jointed and rendered in pale blue hues, suggesting the look of wood or porcelain. The footwear consists of simple black shoes with yellowish soles. The composition is centered, and the doll is the only object present in the drawing.
title: Doll
